text:
michael.ceo: Quick company update — GA launch for Hosted Adaptive Streaming (HAS) today. This adds adaptive chunking + dynamic routing for the hosted streaming endpoints :tada:

tara.prod: Short summary: a single endpoint /v3/has that adapts frame sizes to network conditions and routes to lower-cost model variants when latencies spike. Designed for low-latency assistants and mobile clients.

hugo.eng: Implementation notes: no model changes — we added an adaptive proxy layer that negotiates chunk size, implements backpressure, and can swap to a compatible quantized model variant on the fly. Deployed to hosted clusters now.

vivian.docs: Docs & migration guide published: https://docs.redwood.ai/has/migrate — includes SDK snippets and mobile best-practices for handling reconnects.

noah.sre: Rollout plan: internal preview -> traffic ramp (5% -> 25% -> 75%) over 48h. Monitoring dashboards created for stream p50/p95, reconnect-rate, and variant-fallback-rate. Alerts: reconnect-rate > 3% or fallback-rate > 5% will page. Canary started at 1965432400.

amy-support: CS KB ready and canned responses prepared: https://internal.redwood/kb/has-ga. We'll coordinate emails and in-product banners.

deploy-bot: deploy status: has-proxy v1.0.0 deployed to hosted pools at 1965432500 — health checks passed.

tara.prod: Migration note: old streaming clients will still work but should add reconnect+resume handling. Deprecation timeline for legacy /v2/stream endpoint: 90 days notice before redirect.

hugo.eng: Known limits for GA: max concurrent fallbacks per account = 3, default adaptive min_chunk = 64 tokens, stream idle timeout = 7m. We'll revisit defaults after telemetry.

vivian.docs: Example (Node streaming with reconnect):
```js
const resp = await client.has.stream({ model: 'mosaicx-lite-2', prompt: 'Assist and call tools', stream: true })
for await (const pkt of resp) {
  if (pkt.type === 'chunk') console.log(pkt.text)
  if (pkt.type === 'resume') client.has.resume(pkt.id)
}
```

michael.ceo: Action items: ENG monitor canary metrics 0-72h (hugo.eng, noah.sre); DOCS add mobile reconnect patterns (vivian.docs); SUPPORT schedule customer comms (amy-support). Ping here for urgent regressions — huge congrats team :rocket:
